title: Deterministic legacy importer
description: Objective: import copied frozen old-Moe projects read-only with stable IDs, ordering, provenance, ambiguity classification, and atomic replay. Deliverable: packages/import modules and real-project fixtures. NOT in scope: live legacy reads, write-back, dual write, or activation. Hard dependencies: stable v1 schemas, store migrations, and artifact CAS. Owned paths: packages/import/** and tests/migration/import/**. Verification: pnpm test:migration.
definitionOfDone: Identical source bytes produce identical imported IDs, events, database/export hashes, and counts.
Unsupported or ambiguous records are preserved with typed provenance and never activate.
Interrupted import commits wholly or not at all and legacy bytes remain unchanged.
taskRails: Portability consumes frozen daemon/core contracts; adapters cannot fork lifecycle or authority semantics.
Official MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP only; no custom MCP-over-WebSocket dialect.
Unsupported OS/provider/import facts remain typed UNSUPPORTED or UNKNOWN, never guessed.
IDE adapters are thin optional shells for the standalone control room. Keep files below 400 lines and use explicit owned paths.

comments.author: human
comments.content: Roadmap amendment 2026-08-07: copied legacy .moe/skills content may be imported only through the new versioned skill contract. Preserve source paths and exact bytes/digests; classify malformed, ambiguous, missing-license, unsupported-script, or escaping assets without blessing or executing them.
